caption: The drawing depicts a long, full-skirted dress in muted brownish-gray tones, accompanied by a fitted jacket of the same color, both rendered with visible shading to suggest folds and texture. At the neckline of the garment, a large, light-colored, sheer triangular collar with lace trim is draped over the shoulders and upper chest, distinguished by its translucency and detailing. To the top left of the drawing, a separate and detailed lace pattern is illustrated vertically, showing intricate designs in white. To the right, there is a faint pencil outline of the back view of the dress, focusing on the collar, which again displays sheer fabric and lace edge detailing. The background is a plain, light beige. The name "LILIAN CASEY" is written in small letters near the right side of the drawing.
title: Quaker Dress
